title: IntentRecord
description: A founder intention normalized into a typed institutional object. docs/FOUNDER_INTENT_LEDGER.md specifies this record in prose; this contract is its machine-readable form. An Intent Record is the FIRST link of the Single Bottleneck Metric chain (intent -> decision -> action -> evidence -> outcome). Recording an intent grants no authority: state is a lifecycle classification, never a permission.

statement.description: The intention in the founder's own terms. Preserved verbatim where possible; the Upward Interpretation Rule may strengthen the form but never invent scope.

source_refs.description: Where this intention was found: chat, document, issue, PR, commit, repository path. At least one; an intent with no source is not an intent.

owner.description: The human legal principal accountable for this intention. Never an organ, agent or model.

state.description: Lifecycle classification per docs/FOUNDER_INTENT_LEDGER.md. Only 'implemented' asserts enforcement by code, contract, test, workflow or policy, and only against implementation_refs.

binding_scope.description: Organs, capabilities or domains this intention binds. Empty means it binds nothing yet — it does not mean it binds everything.

constitutional_constraints.description: Constitutional articles or policy clauses that limit how this intention may be pursued.

success_evidence.description: What observable evidence would show this intention satisfied. Declared BEFORE the work, so success cannot be redefined afterwards.

failure_evidence.description: What observable evidence would show this intention failed or was wrong. Preserved; negative results are never deleted.

conflicts.description: Other intents this one contradicts. Conflict is recorded, not silently resolved.

next_review_trigger.description: The condition, dependency or date that forces re-examination. 'never' is not permitted.

supersedes.description: Prior intents this replaces. The prior records are retained, never deleted.

superseded_by.$comment: Null while this intent stands. Set to the successor intent_id when replaced.

implementation_refs.description: Paths, tests or contracts that enforce this intention. An intent in state 'implemented' with no implementation_refs is a false claim and is rejected by the verifier.

recorded_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of normalization into the ledger.
